name: loudnorm-2pass
description: Two-pass EBU R128 loudness normalization: pass 1 measures the input with print_format=json, pass 2 applies the measured values with linear=true, then the output is RE-MEASURED and the reported normalization mode is inspected (ffmpeg loudnorm silently falls back to dynamic when the requested change would exceed the true-peak ceiling).

params.target_lufs: integrated loudness target, -70..-5 (default -14.0; this is a PLAYBACK target, not a distributor requirement)

safety: writes a NEW output under <input dir>/renders/; never overwrites the input
